cases.name: gone-path-tombstones-and-pools
cases.notes: README §5.6: a tombstone commit (reason 'observed deletion'), every live block pooled, the doc's block rows DELETED (17.3, D2 step two — through 17.2 they stayed with `deleted_at`) and the doc row tombstoned (`deleted_at`); no revision, no dispositions. Note the doc's `sections` rows survive the tombstone.
